text:
ella: Heads up — us-west1 dedicated pool 3 saw a p90 latency jump ~12:03 UTC, suspect noisy neighbor from tenant pbd-mlprep. ops-bot already flagged it. anyone available for quick triage?
jon: seeing it on the dashboards too. p99 went from ~2.4s to ~6.8s for gen requests. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/board/allocs?panel=latency :confused: 
priya: can we put that tenant into a temporary dedicated carveout or drop them to a preemptible fallback? what's the expected cost delta for an 8h carveout?
mike: we can route them off the shared slice quickly by adjusting soft-affinity and adding a short-lived dedicated-fallback. low-risk change: reduce soft_affinity weight for pool-3 and raise fallback threshold. example config to apply:
```
route: default
  pools: [pool-3, pool-dedicated-fallback]
  soft_affinity: 0.55
  fallback:
    pool: pool-dedicated-fallback
    ttl: 8h
```
ella: logs from the host show NIC tx queue growth and some NVMe write stalls around the same window, which fits a noisy I/O-heavy job rather than pure GPU saturation: 
```
[2025-02-16T12:03:10Z] host-rack18 nic_tx_full=1242 txq_len=4096 cpu% 72
[2025-02-16T12:03:12Z] host-rack18 nvme_io_wait_ms=85 io_ops=4321
[2025-02-16T12:03:15Z] alloc=pool-3 tenant=pbd-mlprep kvcache_misses=0.62
```
jon: can someone run the tenant fingerprint tool? need to confirm traffic pattern (large batches vs streaming). `./tools/tenant-fingerprint --tenant pbd-mlprep --since 6h` should show request size hist and egress.
priya: quick cost math — if we carve out an 8h dedicated slice for them (2x A100-equivalent), rough incremental cost ~ $420. tradeoff: predicted p99 drops to ~2.5s for co-tenants. if we let it run, customer impact might hit SLOs.
mike: I'm going to stage the routing change as a canary (10% traffic) in 5m, then ramp after 10m if telemetry looks good. also plan to throttle tenant egress to 50mbit as a soft limit to stop NVMe tail amplification. I'll post the rollout command when I run it.
ops-bot: incident created INC-20250216-0091, severity=sev2, assignees=@ella @mike — https://incidents.redwood/INC-20250216-0091
ella: thanks. action items: mike apply canary routing + temp egress cap; jon capture KV cache hit rates and RT histogram for pool-3; priya run cost estimate and prepare a short note for sales if customer needs remediation. i'll coordinate with support for the tenant. :thumbsup:
jon: ack, pulling traces now.
priya: prepping cost delta and a 1-pager. will DM sales if carveout is needed.
mike: applying canary now, command: `rctl patch route default --soft_affinity 0.55 --canary 10% --note "noisy-tenant mitigation"` will monitor for 15m.
ella: appreciate it. will update this thread when p90/p99 stabilize. try to avoid full dedicated carve unless necessary.
jon: early signal looks promising — canary reduced p99 to ~3.0s for shared tenants in the first 3m. continuing to observe.
ella: keep updates here. closing loop once stable; if it reoccurs we'll schedule a longer carveout and postmortem. thanks everyone.
